cases.name: unknown_setting
cases.flow:
mlxflow 0.8
1. Read Text  a.txt
2. Redact  Privacy Filter; threshold=0.5

models:
  Privacy Filter = openai/privacy-filter

issues.message: Row 2's `Redact` takes only `only=` (a comma-separated subset of person, email, phone, url, address, date, account and secret); remove `threshold=`.
